messages:
nina: Hey team, planning a short remote pilot from Athens (Crete) for ~45 days in Aug-Sep. Quick checks: can I stay on US payroll, will WFH stipend be prorated, any tax/PE risk for Redwood, and logistics for company laptop?

sophia-peopleops: Nice! Short answers: probably keep US payroll for <90 days, stipend prorated monthly, need manager sign-off + short-term remote addendum. We'll confirm with payroll/legal.

ryan-payroll: We don't have Greece payroll. For stays under 90 days we usually keep folks on US payroll but require: signed addendum, manager approval, and return date documented. Stipend is prorated by calendar month and paid in USD to your regular account.

legal-bot: Flag: Greece has local rules about dependent agent and personal services. 45 days typically low risk but depends on client/customer contact and any local contracting. We'll run a quick counsel check; avoid local contracting or recruitment.

own: I approve as manager, provided you keep 4h overlap with PST core and update the team calendar. Also confirm on-call coverage if any.

luis: Equipment note 12: shipping company laptops to EU is possible but may incur VAT/customs and asset tagging headaches. Recommend taking travel laptop or we can issue a temporary equipment stipend. If you want company shipment, we need an asset export form and you'll be responsible for customs.

nina: Thanks all. Two micro Qs: 1) Does stipend count as taxable income on US ADP? 2) If I buy a local SIM and a cheap hotspot, is that reimbursable?

ryan-payroll: 1) Stipend shows as USD on your US paystub and is taxed per normal payroll rules. 2) Yes, telecom/hotspot reimbursable up to policy. Keep receipts and use Expensify tag "Remote-Travel".

sophia-peopleops: Next steps: please submit short-term remote form here: https://intranet.redwood/forms/short-term-remote with dates + return flight. We'll issue addendum after manager signs. Expect payroll+legal turnaround ~5 business days.

legal-bot: Opened counsel ticket. If counsel requests changes we'll notify you; options may include shortening stay or limiting external-facing work.

nina: Filing form now. Appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup:
